searchText: Alright, so i have looked into alot of stuff related to the solutions for the Scalability problem when it comes to Ethereum From what i understand, its divided into tackling execution layer (lower level) and/or the consensus layer (higher level) From the developers point of view (those who dont work for Ethereum), we cant actually gain access or even try to change the exectuion layer right? so, the non-Ethereum employed developers usually look for solutions within the consensus layer So, some of the Consensus layer solutions are: 1. Sidechains 2. Rollups 2. Sharding Now, in this case if i want to lets say analyse the TPS based on each solution (mentioned above), that is realistic ?
